case_title: MINA, JOSE LUIS VS CHAVEZ, CARLOS

docket_entries.description: AUTO ACCIDENT CLAIM OF PLAINTIFF FOR $5,000.00 FILED BY MINA, JOSE LUIS AS TO DEFENDANT CHAVEZ, CARLOS ORDER SETTING TRIAL ISSUED FOR DEC-27-1993 AT 08:00 AM IN DEPT 03

PARTIES WAIVE SERVICE ON PLAINTIFF'S CLAIM. THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MINA, JOSE LUIS RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT CHAVEZ, CARLOS $5,000.00 PRINCIPAL, $15.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $5,015.00 STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS
NOTICE OF ENTRY OF JUDGMENT TO CARLOS CHAVEZ RETURNED-NO SUCH NUMBER
